title: Docker registry sign-in config
whyItMatters: Saved registry auth entries in this file can let someone pull or push container images as the account owner.
notes: The auth material is OS-dependent (credential helper or base64 token). The file is never opened by vacate.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of each container registry you are signed in to, using Docker's sign-out option, so the saved entry stops working.
steps: Sign out of every registry account you used with Docker.
Delete the file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the saved registry sign-in from this PC. Registries still accept the old credential until you sign out or revoke the token.
